touch_definition: Contiguous 15m bars spanning the extension form one episode; at least one whole non-touch bar rearms. Count episode starts after the completed Monday and before next NY Monday.
range_return: Upper: price reaches or passes original Monday high downward. Lower: reaches or passes original Monday low upward. No close confirmation required. Deadline next NY Monday, never reset the original edge.
censoring: Current NY week unresolved events remain pending; observed count divided by all original events is not a completed-horizon estimate.
limitations: Descriptive price reachability, no orders/PnL/stops. Several touches can share the same later return. No strategy edge, win rate or independent sample claim; no matching null or p-value is needed for a requested event count.
